test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The doctor assured the patient that the tumour was **__benign__** and could be easily removed
solution: The correct answer is **"Malignant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Malignant' **means harmful or cancerous. ((कैंसर या किसी रोग के कारण बनी गाँठ) जिससे मृत्‍यु भी हो सकती है यदि वह नियंत्रित न हो सके; घातक) • **Example**: *He has a **malignant**__ brain tumour.* • The sentence talks about a tumour that can be easily removed, so the opposite of that would be a tumour that is harmful and difficult to remove. • Grammatically, **'benign'** is an adjective that describes (used about a disease, etc.) not dangerous. (रोग या बीमारी) हलकी, सुसाध्य रोग) __ • **Example**: *A **benign**__ growth is not cancer and is not likely to be harmful.* • The antonym of **'benign'** is **'malignant.'** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: 'Favourable' **means positive or advantageous. (अनुकूल) • **Option 3: 'Sterile'** means not able to produce children or young. (प्रजनन में असमर्थ; नपुंसक, बाँझ, बंध्‍या) • **Option 4: 'Kind' **means friendly or compassionate. (समान गुणों वाले व्यक्तियों का समूह; वर्ग) 3d:Tf6e, The correct answer is** "The new employee was hired by the director after the interview."**
